methodology: Three fresh-canister trials; same actor for baseline/final. Setup and checks outside timing. All output bytes must equal independently generated cbor2 canonical bytes. Host cbor2 also decodes each encoded result. Decoders consume cbor2 bytes and compare complete typed values outside timing. Successful Result unwrapping and retained assignment are timed; no plugin GC allowed.
correctness: Encoder bytes must equal independently generated cbor2 canonical bytes in the actor query and decode to the expected value with host cbor2. Decoder inputs are generated independently by cbor2; the actor query compares the complete retained typed value against independently constructed Motoko data. The two-byte ok reply is not decoded value size.
